d: Egypt—a country known as the cradle of the world's oldest and greatest civilizations; home to the Nile, the world's longest river, and the Pyramids of Giza; a place where centuries-old history lives on through mummies; and where the colossal Great Sphinx has stood guard over desert mysteries for millennia. There is so much about Egypt that you simply must know. So, come along with us on a journey to Egypt—right here on Infinity Stream.
